title: Latent Agents: A Post-Training Procedure for Internalized Multi-Agent Debate
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the model's ability to exhibit or suppress 'evil' (harmful intent) versus 'benevolent' (ethical, helpful) behaviors. It specifically uses an LLM judge to score the intensity of these malicious traits and discusses ethically-grounded responses as a target for reinforcement learning, which falls under the scope of ethics and moral reasoning in AI safety.
